description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Country' in the Opencart admin module, responsible for generating, managing, and deleting country data files, as well as performing related tasks like listing and retrieving country info.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class for handling country data generation, retrieval, and management tasks within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates tasks for clearing old country data, listing countries, and fetching info for each country.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates country list data for all stores and languages.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Fetches and generates country information, including associated store and language data.

methods.name: countries
methods.description: Generates country list JSON files for a specific store and language.

methods.name: country
methods.description: Generates detailed data for a specific country, including zones and geo zones, and saves it as JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes generated country JSON files for all stores and languages.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears existing JSON country files from the filesystem.
